# AQ Coaching

> Executive coaching by Maria Belitskaya, ICF ACC Certified Coach. Strategic, results-driven coaching for founders, executives, and changemakers. Based in Barcelona, working globally.

Maria Belitskaya brings ~20 years of international corporate experience (Levi's, The North Face, Nike, Quiksilver, New Era) to 1:1 executive, leadership, and career coaching. Sessions delivered in English and Russian.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aqcoach.com/): Overview of AQ Coaching services, testimonials, and approach.
- [About Maria Belitskaya](https://aqcoach.com/about): Background, certifications (ICF ACC, CEC, EQ-i 2.0), and career history.
- [Book a Session](https://aqcoach.com/book): Request a complimentary 30-minute discovery call.
- [Privacy Policy](https://aqcoach.com/privacy-policy): GDPR-compliant data handling policy.

## Services

- Executive & Leadership Coaching (1:1, team, and programmes)
- Career & Personal Coaching (typically 10 sessions over 6–8 months)
- Mentoring for creative-industry leaders
- Strategy Sessions (focused 2-hour working sessions)
- EQ-i 2.0 / EQ 360 psychometric assessments
